title: Waves & Sound
summary: Waves carry energy without transporting matter. The wave relation $v=f\lambda$ links speed, frequency, and wavelength. Sound is a longitudinal wave; standing waves on strings and in pipes set musical pitches, and the Doppler effect shifts observed frequency with motion.

wave.plain: A disturbance carrying energy through a medium.

concept_sections.heading: Wave basics
concept_sections.explanation: A wave transfers energy without moving the medium along with it. Key quantities: wavelength $\lambda$, frequency $f$, and amplitude.

concept_sections.heading: The wave equation
concept_sections.explanation: Speed, frequency, and wavelength are tied together by $v=f\lambda$. Solve for any one given the others.
math_steps: Wave speed is set by the medium.

concept_sections.heading: Sound as a longitudinal wave
concept_sections.explanation: Sound is a pressure wave whose vibrations run along the travel direction. Its speed depends on the medium (fastest in solids).

concept_sections.heading: Standing waves and pitch
concept_sections.explanation: Reflections create standing waves with fixed nodes; strings and pipes support specific wavelengths (harmonics) that set musical pitches.

concept_sections.heading: The Doppler effect
concept_sections.explanation: When a source and observer move relative to each other, the observed frequency rises on approach and falls on recession.
math_steps: The shift grows with relative speed.

real_world_examples.title: Tuning a guitar
real_world_examples.how_the_math_applies: The standing-wave frequency $v=f\lambda$ shifts with wave speed on the string.

real_world_examples.title: An ambulance siren
real_world_examples.scenario: The pitch drops as it passes.
real_world_examples.how_the_math_applies: The Doppler effect raises then lowers the observed frequency.

real_world_examples.title: Echoes in a canyon
real_world_examples.scenario: A shout returns after a delay.
real_world_examples.how_the_math_applies: Sound's finite speed and $v=f\lambda$ set the echo timing.
